intructions.title: How to play
intructions.body_1: Help Shaun score by smashing up as much as possible in 5 shots
intructions.body_2: Set your ball's angle and power by clicking the buttons or use your spacebar
intructions.body_3: Use your mouse or spacebar to control the flippers while the ball�s in play

instruction_panel.title: GET READY TO PLAY
instruction_panel.description: Get points by smashing things! Use keyboard or mouse.

recycle.title: RECYCLE BOX
recycle.desc: Use the recycle box lid as a flipper to punt the ball.

moped.title: MOPED TOP BOX
moped.desc: Click the mouse to flip the lid. If you catch the ball just right, it'll go flying!

duck.title: DUCK
duck.desc: Click the mouse to make the duck bob and dive. If the ball is nearby, he'll flick it away fast.

toilet.title: TOILET SEAT
toilet.desc: Click the mouse to make the toilet seat flip up. Use it to flip the ball around.

molehill.title: MOLE HILL
molehill.desc: Click the mouse to make a mole pop up. He can bash the ball about too.

pigsty.title: PIG STY
pigsty.desc: Bash this metal tunnel to rudely awaken the pig sleeping inside!

moleinone.title: MOLE HILL
moleinone.desc: Earn the 'mole in one' achievement by dropping the ball into this mole hill.

record.title: RECORD PLAYER
record.desc: If the ball hits the record, it'll be flung off at high speed.

slide.title: RICKETY SLIDE
slide.desc: Drop the ball onto the top of this and it'll gather points all the way down.

balloons.title: BALLOONS
balloons.desc: Strike the balloons three times to release them all and earn an achievement.

drainpipe.title: DRAINPIPE
drainpipe.desc: Drop into the drainpipe and the ball will land at Shaun's feet. Quick, take a sneaky second shot!

mopedachievement.title: MOPED TOP BOX
mopedachievement.desc: Can you trap the ball inside the box three times? It'll earn you an achievement.

tyre.title: TRACTOR TYRE
tyre.desc: If the ball hits this tyre, it'll get a powerful speed boost.

shaun.title: SNEAKY SECOND SHOT
shaun.desc: If the ball is by Shaun's feet, click the mouse to take another swipe at it. Go on, nobody's looking.

bucket.title: SHOWER BUCKET
bucket.desc: Hit the bucket three times to open the shed door and see what's going on inside.

vegbox.title: VEG-BOX
vegbox.desc: Click the mouse to make the veg-box doors fly open. They'll bat the ball around and give it an extra boost.

flagpole.title: FLAG POLE
flagpole.desc: You get lots of points for plonking the ball in the hole under the flag.

deckchair.title: DECKCHAIR
deckchair.desc: The deckchair flings the ball away. Good for smashing lots of the nearby glass.

flush.title: TOILET
flush.desc: Drop the ball into the toilet and it'll come flying out of the U-bend.

molejump.title: MOLE HILL
molejump.desc: Click the mouse and a mole will leap out of this mound. He can knock the ball to the sides.

greenhouse.title: GREENHOUSE
greenhouse.desc: Smash the glass for an easy score multiplier.

gnomes.title: GARDEN GNOMES
gnomes.desc: Earn an achievement by knocking over or smashing all three gnomes in one game.

tractor.title: TRACTOR FUNNEL
tractor.desc: Drop the ball in here and it'll come shooting out of another part of the tractor.

bath.title: BATHTUB
bath.desc: Mysterious forces inside the bath fling the ball out at high speed.

scoop.title: TRACTOR BUCKET
scoop.desc: Drop the ball into the bucket and it'll be shot back out at high speed.
